title: Urn is the size of a thimble; will only hold a small fraction of ashes; inscription is too tiny
text:
Urn is the size of a thimble; will only hold a small fraction of ashes; inscription is too tiny. One would think this is a necklace with how small this urn is. This will only hold a thimbleful of ashes. The inscription on the front is microscopic and definitely not as clear as the Amazon site shows. It says "God has you in his arms I have you in my heart" and there is a heart image on either side of the word "heart." 

In this package are three cleaning cloths, a plastic spoon to scoop in the ashes, a  pouch for the urn, and the tiny thimble-sized urn. Also, the urn is not shiny and clear as pictured on Amazon. It is not great at all.

To me this is not worth the purchase.
